subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The White Stag
description: A quick win: understand The White Stag.

hook.text: In Celtic and Arthurian legend, a white stag appears in the forest. Chasing it leads heroes into the unknown.

buildup.text: The white stag can never be caught. It's always just ahead, leading the hunter deeper into the enchanted wood.

discovery.text: In Narnia, the Pevensie children chase a white stag and stumble back into our world. The stag marks boundaries.

twist.text: The stag isn't prey—it's a guide. The chase itself is the point. The destination is transformation, not capture.

climax.text: The white stag is the unattainable goal that pulls you forward. The pursuit shapes the hero, not the catch.

punchline.text: Chase it. You'll never catch it. That's why.

quiz.question: What does the white stag symbolize in mythology?
options: An unattainable goal that transforms the pursuer
